title: Usage Ledger with Typed Errors and Exception Groups
instructions: Implement the usage ledger in `ledger.py`: the `InvalidEvent` error, the frozen slotted dataclasses `UsageEvent` (keyword-only) and `Summary`, `parse_event` and `summarize`. `parse_event` turns every failure into `InvalidEvent` with a proper `__cause__`, and `summarize` aggregates tokens per tenant with a `Counter`, collects errors by position, and in `strict` mode raises them together as an `ExceptionGroup`.

evidence.label: Collects errors with their index and keeps going
InvalidEvent stores index and reason and sits under LedgerError
parse_event builds a UsageEvent with a default model
parse_event only raises InvalidEvent for every bad input
UsageEvent is frozen, slotted, keyword-only and validated
Summary has non-shared empty defaults and is frozen and slotted
Strict mode raises an ExceptionGroup after processing everything
Strict mode returns normally when clean
